This is a common practice in AUR packages when automatic signature verification is not enforced.

The build process is transparent and safe: it removes pycache directories, installs Python files to standard locations, and creates a simple launcher script. No network requests, obfuscated code, or suspicious commands (e.g., curl|bash, eval, base64 decoding) are present. All operations are confined to the build and package directories, with no attempts to access sensitive files, exfiltrate data, or modify system state beyond the package installation.

The optdepends on `sway` is contextual and expected, as the package description indicates integration with the hypeForge desktop on Sway. The maintainer-provided URL and source locations are consistent and point to the official repository. There is no evidence of injected malicious code, supply-chain attacks, or unauthorized behavior.
</details>
